run_FF_analysis: run the FF_analysis module to generate force field error plots and MAE statistics for CO2 and H2O
get_data_from_json: load a JSON file of DFT and force field data points and split into CO2 and H2O lists
plot_raw_error_histogram: generate a histogram of raw force field minus DFT errors for CO2 and H2O molecules
calculate_physisorption_error: compute the mean absolute error for physisorption points where DFT energy is between 0 and -0.5 eV
calculate_chemisorption_error: compute the mean absolute error for chemisorption points where DFT energy is between -0.5 and -2 eV
